The Investor Operations Manager will be responsible for solving investors' problems on a day-to-day basis and developing good relationships with them over time. A good understanding of the Commercial Real Estate Sector, expertise in Commercial Real Estate software Appofolio are needed to be successful in this role. Essentially, you will act as the main point of contact for our investors, investors day- to- day questions and ensuring a seamless and engaging experience.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Understanding of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools and technologies.

  • Good understanding of Appofolio is a must

  • Onboarding investors into the Investor Portal and managing the portal.

  • Creating a delightful experience and strengthening relationships with investors.

  • CreatingInvestor Education Seminarsand Managing the end to end process (invitations, materials, checklists, invite followups, etc )

  • Keeping investors updated on the latest deals.

  • Building and maintaining profitable relationships with investors.

  • Expanding the investor base by helping founders with investor education material preparation

Requirements

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Familiarity with CRM tools and digital marketing strategies is a plus.

Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator

30+ Hours/Week | Fully Remote | U.S. Business Hours
Industry: Real Estate Investing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and analytical Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator to help manage a growing real estate investment pipeline from initial opportunity through closing.

This role combines deal analysis, transaction coordination, CRM management, and stakeholder communication. You’ll work behind the scenes to evaluate opportunities, keep transactions organized, track deadlines, and ensure deals continue moving forward.

If you have experience in real estate investing, acquisitions, transaction coordination, or deal operations and enjoy working with both numbers and people, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Do

Deal Analysis

  • Review property information, transaction structures, and investment opportunities
  • Analyze financial and operational data to support acquisition decisions
  • Prepare clear deal summaries and recommendations for leadership
  • Identify potential risks or issues before deals progress

Deal Pipeline & Transaction Coordination

  • Track opportunities from lead through closing
  • Monitor deadlines, milestones, follow-ups, and outstanding items
  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks that could delay transactions
  • Maintain clear visibility into every active deal and its next steps

Buyer, Seller & Partner Coordination

  • Coordinate with buyers, sellers, agents, title companies, and internal teams
  • Schedule calls, meetings, and transaction follow-ups
  • Maintain proactive communication throughout the deal lifecycle
  • Ensure stakeholders remain aligned on timelines and requirements

CRM & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate deal stages, notes, and activity inside the CRM
  • Organize transaction documents and supporting information
  • Prepare pipeline reports and deal updates
  • Ensure records remain complete, accurate, and accessible

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies across deal workflows
  • Improve tracking, communication, and documentation processes
  • Help increase deal velocity and overall team productivity

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in real estate operations, acquisitions, transaction coordination, deal management, or similar roles
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to evaluate property and transaction data
  • Understanding of real estate deal workflows
  • Excellent organization and project-management skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Experience with CRM systems and Google Workspace
  • Ability to manage multiple active transactions simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Reliable internet and availability for 30+ hours per week during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Real estate investing or wholesaling experience
  • Acquisitions or dispositions experience
  • Familiarity with U.S. real estate transactions and terminology
  • Experience with Podio, Follow Up Boss, REI BlackBook, or similar systems
  • Experience supporting high-volume real estate pipelines

What Success Looks Like

  • Deals progress efficiently from lead through closing
  • Deadlines and critical follow-ups are never missed
  • CRM and transaction records remain accurate
  • Buyers, sellers, agents, and partners receive timely communication
  • Leadership has clear visibility into deal status and next steps
  • Process improvements increase deal velocity and operational efficiency

Why Join?

  • Fully remote opportunity
  • Consistent 30+ hour/week schedule
  • Exposure to a high-volume real estate investment operation
  • Strong ownership across deal analysis and coordination
  • Collaborative, growth-focused environment
  • Long-term opportunity to grow within real estate operations and acquisitions

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Qualified candidates will receive a Spark Hire invitation to complete a short Intro Video. This helps the hiring team learn more about your real estate experience, communication skills, and background managing transactions or deal pipelines.

Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in real estate transactions or investment operations, are comfortable analyzing deals, and know how to keep multiple transactions organized and moving toward closing, we’d love to hear from you.

Real Estate Specialist (Transaction Coordinator, MLS & DocuSign) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Real Estate Specialist to manage transaction coordination, MLS listings, compliance workflows, documentation, and closing operations.

This is not a basic administrative role. You’ll play a critical role in keeping real estate transactions organized and moving smoothly from accepted offer through closing.

You’ll coordinate closely with real estate agents, brokers, buyers and sellers, lenders, escrow officers, title companies, inspectors, and appraisers to ensure deadlines are met, documents are complete, and every transaction remains compliant.

If you have hands-on experience with transaction coordination, MLS platforms, DocuSign, and real estate documentation, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Transaction Coordination – Core Focus

Manage 5–15+ active real estate transactions simultaneously from accepted offer through closing.

You’ll:

  • Maintain transaction checklists and timelines
  • Track milestones and closing requirements
  • Monitor contingency deadlines
  • Coordinate inspections and appraisals
  • Track financing and lender milestones
  • Monitor closing dates and outstanding requirements
  • Follow up proactively on missing documents or approvals
  • Ensure nothing falls through the cracks before closing

Coordinate with:

  • Real estate agents and brokers
  • Buyers and sellers
  • Escrow officers
  • Title companies
  • Lenders
  • Inspectors
  • Appraisers

MLS Listing Management

Create, update, and maintain accurate property listings across MLS platforms.

You’ll:

  • Enter and update listing information
  • Maintain accurate property details, pricing, status, and documentation
  • Ensure listings meet MLS requirements
  • Coordinate listing changes and status updates
  • Support syndication across platforms such as:
    • Zillow
    • Realtor.com
    • Apartments.com
    • Brokerage websites and platforms
  • Track listing activity and provide updates to agents

Contracts, Compliance & Documentation

Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready transaction files.

You’ll manage:

  • Purchase agreements
  • Contracts
  • Disclosures
  • Amendments
  • Addenda
  • Signatures
  • Closing documentation

You’ll also:

  • Review files for missing documents or signatures
  • Maintain transaction compliance checklists
  • Follow brokerage procedures
  • Support compliance with applicable state and MLS requirements
  • Organize files for brokerage reviews and audits

DocuSign & Transaction Management Systems

Manage document workflows using DocuSign and transaction management platforms.

You’ll:

  • Prepare documents for electronic signature
  • Create and manage signature workflows
  • Track outstanding signatures
  • Follow up on incomplete documents
  • Maintain properly executed copies
  • Upload and organize completed documents within transaction files

Experience with platforms such as Dotloop, SkySlope, Brokermint, or similar systems is highly valuable.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Provide proactive and professional communication throughout the transaction lifecycle.

You’ll:

  • Keep buyers, sellers, agents, and brokers informed
  • Coordinate with lenders, title companies, and escrow teams
  • Schedule inspections, appraisals, showings, and closings
  • Communicate upcoming deadlines and requirements
  • Follow up on outstanding items
  • Respond promptly to transaction-related questions
  • Help create a smooth client experience from contract through closing

Real Estate Marketing Support

Support agents with listing-related marketing activities, including:

  • Property flyers
  • Brochures
  • Open house materials
  • Social media assets
  • Listing updates
  • Basic marketing coordination

Reporting & Brokerage Operations

Maintain visibility across the transaction pipeline.

You’ll:

  • Prepare transaction status reports
  • Track active and upcoming closings
  • Monitor commissions and closing timelines
  • Maintain pipeline trackers
  • Support brokerage compliance reviews
  • Maintain organized transaction and operational records

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Have strong attention to documentation and compliance
  • Can manage multiple active transactions without missing details
  • Follow up proactively rather than waiting for reminders
  • Communicate professionally with clients and real estate professionals
  • Stay calm when deadlines shift or transactions become complicated
  • Understand the importance of accurate real estate documentation
  • Take ownership from contract through closing
  • Work effectively and independently in a remote environment

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Transaction coordination
    • Real estate operations
    • Brokerage support
    • Real estate administration
  • Hands-on experience with MLS platforms
  • Strong experience with DocuSign
  • Experience with transaction management platforms such as:
    • Dotloop
    • SkySlope
    • Brokermint
    • Similar real estate transaction systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Real estate contracts
    • Disclosures
    • Transaction timelines
    • Contingencies
    • Closing workflows
    • Compliance documentation
  • Ability to manage multiple active transactions simultaneously
  • Strong Google Workspace or Microsoft Office skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Active real estate license
  • Transaction Coordinator certification
  • Experience managing 10+ concurrent transactions
  • Residential and/or commercial real estate experience
  • Experience supporting high-volume brokerages
  • Familiarity with:
    • Canva
    • Adobe InDesign
    • Real estate marketing tools
  • Experience supporting:
    • Real estate investment teams
    • Property management operations
    • Multi-agent brokerages

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might:

  • Review active transactions and upcoming deadlines
  • Update transaction checklists and files
  • Follow up on missing documents and signatures
  • Send and monitor DocuSign envelopes
  • Update MLS listings and property statuses
  • Coordinate inspections and appraisals
  • Communicate with lenders, title companies, and escrow officers
  • Update agents and clients on transaction progress
  • Track contingencies and financing milestones
  • Prepare transaction and closing reports
  • Verify documentation before upcoming closings

In short: You ensure every real estate transaction remains organized, compliant, documented, and on schedule from contract through closing.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Zero missed contingency or closing deadlines
  • Accurate and compliant transaction documentation
  • On-time and smooth closings
  • Accurate MLS listings and updates
  • Timely completion of DocuSign workflows
  • Organized and audit-ready transaction files
  • Strong communication with agents, clients, lenders, and vendors
  • High responsiveness and operational reliability

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own critical parts of the real estate transaction lifecycle
  • Work closely with agents, brokers, lenders, title companies, and clients
  • Build expertise across MLS, compliance, contracts, and closings
  • High-ownership remote environment
  • Clear and structured operational responsibilities
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Transaction Coordinator
    • Brokerage Operations
    • Real Estate Operations Manager
    • Compliance Coordinator / Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have hands-on real estate transaction coordination experience
  • Are confident using MLS platforms and DocuSign
  • Understand contracts, disclosures, contingencies, and closing timelines
  • Can manage multiple transactions without missing deadlines
  • Thrive in organized, detail-heavy, fast-moving environments

This is a strong opportunity to take ownership of real estate transaction operations while working remotely with a growing U.S.-based team.

Role Summary

We are seeking an analytical and action-oriented Real Estate Transactions Manager to be the “engine room” of our infrastructure acquisition team. In this role, you will take identified sites and drive them from initial interest to a signed lease or purchase agreement. You’ll specialize in high-power EV charging sites, vehicle service centers, and parking facilities.

You will not just track deals; you will actively unblock them. You will serve as the central node connecting Legal, Finance, Technical and external broker teams, aggregating their inputs into clear, actionable Deal Summaries for our Investment Committee. Your goal is to maximize pipeline velocity while minimizing risk.

Key Responsibilities

1. Pipeline & Transaction Management

  • Funnel Velocity:Manage a high volume of active real estate transactions simultaneously, ensuring sites meet our location, technical and cost requirements, track critical dates and hold stakeholders accountable to timelines.

  • Negotiation Support:Outline key terms for Letters of Intent (LOIs). Partner with legal counsel to redline leases and related contracts, ensuring commercial terms align with company targets.

  • Deal Closing: Manage the closing checklist, ensuring all contingencies (zoning, title, survey, environmental) are cleared prior to execution.

  • Collaborate with local teams:Coordinate and streamline communication between Moove headquarters and the Japan team, driving efficient information sharing, cross-functional collaboration, and decision-making for real estate transactions.

2. Cross-Functional Due Diligence

  • The “Quarterback”:Act as the central point of contact during the diligence period. You are responsible for pulling in the right experts at the right time.

    • Construction & Utilities:Coordinate with the project delivery teams of external partners to validate site buildability and power availability (MW capacity).

    • Legal:Coordinate with internal and external counsel to advance zoning, land use, and permitting reviews.

    • Finance:Collaborate to ensure deal economics fit within our CAPEX and OPEX models.

3. Investment Analysis & Reporting

  • Deal Summaries:Synthesize complex data—financial models, site layouts, risk assessments, and legal constraints—into concise Investment Committee (IC) Memos that drive “Go/No-Go” decisions.

  • Financial Modeling:Run pro formas and sensitivity analyses to test deal viability under different scenarios (e.g., changing utility rates, construction cost variances).

  • Database Management: Maintain the “Single Source of Truth” in our real estate database (e.g., Google Sheets, Asana), ensuring all deal data is accurate and up to date.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience, including a minimum of 3+ years of direct experience in commercial real estate transactions, development, or real estate private equity

  • The “Closer” Mindset:Demonstrated experience managing transactions from LOI to execution. You understand the mechanics of a real estate deal.

  • Analytical Skills:Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (financial modeling)

  • Language Skills:Business-level proficiency in both Japanese and English (written and spoken)

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Business, or a related field

  • Experience with infrastructure or industrial assets (e.g., data centers, solar farms, logistics, or EV charging)

  • Understanding of municipal zoning and land-use entitlements

  • Familiarity with commercial or industrial real estate leases

  • Familiarity with Japanese real estate market dynamics, local regulations, and public bidding processes

Success Attributes

  • Structured Thinker:You can take a messy email thread involving a lawyer, an engineer, and a landlord, and turn it into a clear list of action items.

  • Bias for Action:You don’t wait for permission to follow up, remove blockers and rally cross-team efforts.

  • Risk Radar:You have an eye for detail and can spot “deal killers” (like a restrictive easement or a bad indemnity clause) early in the process.

  • Collaborative:You understand that getting a deal done requires building consensus across multiple internal teams with competing priorities.
